parties: Dhoot Transmission Limited (issuer); BC Asia Investments XV Limited (Bain Capital – selling shareholder); Rahul Radhavallabh Dhoot (promoter – selling shareholder); Axis Capital Limited, Jefferies India Private Limited, Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Limited, Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities (India) Private Limited, SBI Capital Markets Limited, 360 ONE WAM Limited (book running lead managers)
headline: Dhoot Transmission, India's No. 2 wiring harness manufacturer, completed a ₹3,067 cr book-built IPO with 74.21x subscription, listing at ₹1,200 per share (37.77% premium).
sum: Dhoot Transmission's ₹3,066.89 crore IPO (fresh issue ₹1,400 cr + OFS ₹1,667 cr) listed on 17 Aug 2026 at ₹1,200 on BSE/NSE, marking 37.77% listing gain. The offering saw extreme demand with 212.92x QIB subscription and 74.21x overall subscription, driven by institutional interest. Bain Capital (BC Asia Investments XV) exited ~55% stake partially, while founder-promoter Rahul Dhoot scaled down. Company will deploy proceeds for debt repayment (₹464.8 cr), subsidiary investments (₹301.77 cr), and two new wiring harness plants in Haryana and Tamil Nadu (₹150 cr).
implication: Capital structure: fresh-cum-OFS blend with strong PE exit optionality; the dual selling-shareholder structure (financial investor + founder) enabled clean market-based pricing and price discovery at ₹871 (midway between Bain's March 2026 preferential issue at ₹461.22 and public market appetite), signalling founder intent to retain operational control while LP achieves IRR >49% in 18 months.
detail: Incorporated 1998, Dhoot Transmission is the #2 player in India's two-wheeler/three-wheeler wiring harness market with 41% share; #1 in e-2W/3W segment (70% share). FY26 revenue ₹4,563.70 cr (+31% YoY), PAT ₹396.84 cr (+12% YoY). IPO opened 10 Aug, closed 12 Aug 2026; allotment 13 Aug; listed 17 Aug on BSE (₹1,200) and NSE (₹1,193.80). Price band ₹829–₹871; final price ₹871. Lead manager Axis Capital; registrar Kfin Technologies. Anchor raise ₹918.26 cr on 7 Aug. Fresh issue size 1.61 cr shares; OFS 1.91 cr shares. Use of proceeds: debt reduction, subsidiary capex, manufacturing plant setup in Jhajjar (Haryana) and Hosur (Tamil Nadu), M&A and corporate purposes.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, Reg. 10–11 & Schedule VI
framework.note: central: ICDR framework governs IPO mechanics (book-building, QIB-HNI-retail allocation, anchor investor participation, pricing band, subscription closure timeline).
central: governs fresh issue of equity shares by company and any prior preferential allotments (Bain's March 2026 tranche).

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible Securities) Regulations, 2015 (listing eligibility)
framework.note: central: company qualifies for mainboard listing on BSE/NSE; no special instrument structures involved.

framework.ref: Depositories Act, 1996 & SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
framework.note: central: equity shares to be held in dematerialised form via CDSL/NSDL; registrar Kfin Technologies administers allotment and credit to demat.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: central: post-listing continuous disclosure obligations; promoter shareholding statements; substantial acquisition rules (Bain's OFS exit reduces stake from 55% to ~43%).

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 & Rules, 2015 (Schedule I, II & IV)
framework.note: Bain Capital investment structure: BC Asia Investments XV is a foreign entity; dividend repatriation and exit proceeds (OFS) require FEMA compliance and RBI approval for outbound remittance.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961, § 47 & 48 (capital gains on share transfer)
framework.note: OFS sale by Bain and founder triggers capital gains; long-term vs. short-term depends on holding period; Section 47(vib) exempts IPO listing gains if shares held >2 years.
Buyback route was not used; fresh issue + OFS blend is standard for IPO capital raise.

structure.consideration: ₹3,066.89 crore raised (= 35,218,047 equity shares @ ₹871 per share, face value ₹2). Fresh issue: ₹1,400 crore (1.61 crore shares, net cash to company). Offer for sale: ₹1,666.89 crore (1.91 crore shares, cash to selling shareholders BC Asia Investments XV Limited ~55% stake & Rahul Dhoot founder ~29.87% pre-IPO).

structure.novel: Dual-promoter OFS structure (financial PE investor + founder joint exit) in high-growth auto-component IPO; combined fresh + OFS with material capex deployment (₹150 cr for new manufacturing plants in Haryana & Tamil Nadu) signalled expansion into EV wiring harness segment. Strong institutional demand (212.92x QIB) vs retail lag (8.12x) typical of capex-heavy industrial IPO.

triggers.note: Core IPO trigger: 35M+ share issuance and public offer mandate ICDR framework for disclosure, pricing, allocation, and listing compliance.

triggers.law: SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices) Regulations, 2003 & (Market Manipulation) Regulations, 2003
triggers.note: IPO pricing and allotment must comply with fair trading rules; no insider trading or market-rigging via grey market premium.
Post-listing disclosures (shareholding, related-party transactions, substantial acquisition) flow from mainboard rules; promoter pledge of shares requires stock exchange notice.
Public offer mechanics (prospectus, allotment process, shareholder approvals) governed by company law; fresh share capital requires board/shareholder authorization.
BC Asia's OFS exit (foreign investor selling to Indians) is a capital account transaction; repatriation of sale proceeds overseas requires RBI resident/non-resident account compliance.
